_comment: ✍️ The write script. Every mutation runs in order against ONE context built from the shared repository records, so a later mutation sees what an earlier one wrote. The projection is the payload of each mutation, then the event trail, then the record set as it stands at the end — a mutation that silently did nothing fails the same way one that did the wrong thing does.

mutations.source: mutation { goalCreate(input: { title: "Rust Executor", description: "Port the executor", prompt: "port it", dueDate: "2026-11-30", llm: "opus", effort: "high", client: "claude-code", parent: "repo-rust", milestone: "milestones/13" }) { id title status dueDate milestone parent } }
mutation { goalChange(id: "rust-executor", input: { title: "Rust Executor Half", dueDate: "2026-12-15" }) { id title dueDate } }
mutation { goalClose(input: { id: "docs", summary: "the docs are written" }) { id status } }
mutation { goalReopen(input: { id: "docs", prompt: "more docs", client: "codex", llm: "gpt" }) { id status prompt client llm } }
mutation { todoCreate(input: { name: "Port The Errors", description: "the failing half", parentId: "file:repo/rust/lib.rs" }) { id name description parentId } }
mutation { todoChange(input: { id: "port-the-errors", description: "the refusing half" }) { id description } }
mutation { todoDelete(id: "write-docs") }
mutation { draftCreate(input: { title: "Executor Draft", files: ["repo/rust/lib.rs"] }) { id } }
mutation { draftDelete(id: "draft-two") }

mutation { ticketOpen(input: { emoji: "🧱️", title: "Port The Resolvers", prompt: "port the resolvers", llm: "opus", effort: "high", client: CLAUDE_CODE, goal: "repo-rust", parent: "PORT-EXECUTOR" }) { id year month day slug title emoji status prompt llm effort client goal parent path dates { started finished } } }
mutation { ticketChange(input: { year: 2026, month: 9, day: 6, slug: "PORT-THE-RESOLVERS", title: "Port The Resolver Half", goal: "docs" }) { slug title goal } }

mutation { ticketClose(input: { year: 2026, month: 9, day: 6, slug: "PORT-THE-RESOLVERS", summary: "resolvers ported", files: ["repo/rust/lib.rs"] }) { slug status dates { finished } interactions { kind prompt author } } }
mutation { ticketReopen(input: { year: 2026, month: 9, day: 5, slug: "SPLIT-GO", prompt: "split it again", client: CODEX, llm: "gpt", effort: "medium" }) { slug status llm client } }

mutation { contributorAdd(input: { github: "fable", name: "Fable", names: ["Fable"], email: "fable@example.com", emails: ["fable@example.com"], fingerprint: "DDEEFF" }) { id github name email fingerprint } }
mutation { contributorRemove(github: "opus") }
mutation { folderCreate(path: "repo/docs") { id path uri name kind } }
mutation { folderMove(src: "repo/docs", dst: "repo/manual") { path name uri } }
mutation { folderDelete(path: "repo/rust") }
mutation { fileCreate(path: "repo/manual/index.md") { id path uri name extension kind } }
mutation { fileMove(src: "repo/manual/index.md", dst: "repo/manual/README.md") { path name uri } }
mutation { fileDelete(path: "README.md") }
mutation { sectionCreate(file: "repo/go/main.go", name: "Footer") { id name path } }
mutation { sectionMove(file: "repo/go/main.go", oldName: "Footer", newName: "Trailer") { name path } }
mutation { sectionDelete(file: "repo/go/main.go", name: "Header") }
mutation { extract(sourceFile: "repo/go/main.go", sourceSection: "Trailer", targetFile: "repo/go/trailer.go") { path name } }
mutation { integrate(source: "repo/go/trailer.go", targetSection: "Header", targetFile: "repo/go/main.go") { path name } }
mutation { syncManagement }
mutation Close($id: String!) { goalClose(input: { id: $id, summary: "closed by variable" }) { id status summary: id } }
